_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. ableton.com's SASS build declares no CSS custom properties (raw/css-vars.json is an empty resolved map — only two cross-origin sheets, the Adobe Typekit kit, were unreadable), so every leaf carries a measured "value" and names the measurement in "source" (an anchor of raw/measurements.md, written from raw/components-computed.json). One theme: the public marketing site is light, with a black consent card and dark bands on product pages.

blue.source: measured backgroundColor of scroll-down / pack-download / trial-download / login-submit / newsletter-submit / cookie-accept; color of nav-trial-cta / collapse-toggle border
blue.description: #0000ff, the signature Ableton blue: every primary button, text links, the scroll-down chevron, category badges' companion. The site's one accent.

blue-deep.source: measured backgroundColor of btn-buy; color of anchor-link
blue-deep.description: #0032e6, the deeper blue of the boxed Buy-now button and feature anchor links

blue-hover.source: measured borderTopColor/backgroundColor of btn-buy at hover and pressed
blue-hover.description: #042b9f, the hover state of the deep-blue buttons

black.source: measured color of nav-link / footer-link / blog-teaser-title and backgroundColor of cookie-bar
black.description: #000: all body and display text, the consent card fill

white.source: measured backgroundColor of footer / collapse-toggle and color of hero-title / btn-buy / cookie text
white.description: #fff: the page and card ground, text on blue buttons and on photo tiles, the outline buttons' border on the black consent card

field-gray.source: measured backgroundColor of newsletter-field / login-field / register-field

salmon.description: #ff8389, the pink-salmon of the blog category badges

packs-green.source: measured color of packs-title and textStyle of pack-card (default and hover)
packs-green.description: #00ffaf, the Packs catalogue's accent: the banner title and the pack card's name

note-lime.description: #d6ff00, the Note product accent its page title carries

focus-orange.source: measured outlineColor of btn-try at focus-visible (solid 2px)
focus-orange.description: #ff764d, the focus ring the boxed buttons draw for keyboard focus

focus-blue.source: measured outlineColor of nav-link / footer-link / pack-download at focus-visible (auto 1px)
focus-blue.description: #005fcc, the auto-style focus ring on text links

lime-stripe.source: read off the home promo card's striped background (home-promo-card painted layers) — approximate; the stripes alternate with pale blue
lime-stripe.description: the lime of the rent-to-own promo stripes (a patterned cell, not a flat fill)

futura.source: measured fontFamily of every component (futura-pt on most; "Futura PT" on the boxed buttons)
futura.description: Futura PT (Adobe Typekit) is the single face of the site — nav, body, display, buttons

display.source: measured fontSize of hero-title / live-title / live-section-title
display.description: 60px, the display step (abl-type-60) for hero and section headlines at desktop

section.description: 40px, panel and section headlines on the home/blog index

body.source: measured fontSize of nav-link / footer-link / newsletter-field / login-field / cookie-accept / btn-buy
body.description: 20px, the working size: nav links, body copy, fields, all buttons

meta.source: measured fontSize of nav-login / cookie-bar body copy
meta.description: 16px, secondary nav text and the consent card's copy

display.description: 78px on the product pages' display step (1.3)

body.source: measured lineHeight of nav-link / footer-link / buttons
body.description: 30px on 20px text (1.5) — the everywhere line height

bold.source: measured fontWeight of nav-link / every headline / every button / badge
bold.description: 700 — headlines, buttons, nav links, badges: almost the whole interface

regular.source: measured fontWeight of cookie-bar copy / add-to-cart link / body text
regular.description: 400 — long copy, the consent card, footer body

none.source: measured borderRadius of every component — buttons, fields, cards and badges are all square
none.description: Ableton's signature: no rounded corners anywhere on the marketing site

fast.source: measured transitionDuration on nav/footer links and buttons (the common colour/fade step)
fast.description: the standard link and button transition

content-width.source: measured rect width of panel-title / packs-title / collapse-toggle

button-height.source: measured rect height of trial-download / cookie-accept / newsletter-submit (48px on btn-buy)

button-pad-x.source: measured paddingRight/Left of every abl-button (30px flanks)

field-height.source: measured rect height of login-field / register-field / newsletter-field (42px on the footer field)

button.description: the button and nav-link style: 20/30 bold

surface.source: cards and the collapse row fill

surface-inverse.source: cookie-bar fill and dark photo bands

text-inverse.source: hero-title / button text on blue and on photo tiles

accent.source: the primary blue of every CTA and text link

accent-deep.source: boxed Buy button and anchor links

border.source: the only visible borders: 2px blue on the collapse row, 1px deep blue on the boxed Buy button (forms and cards are borderless)
border.description: borders appear only on outlined controls; the default 'border' is the accent

button-primary-bg.source: scroll-down / pack-download / trial-download / login-submit / newsletter-submit backgroundColor

button-deep-bg.description: the boxed Buy button's deeper blue

button-deep-hover-bg.source: btn-buy borderTopColor/backgroundColor at hover and pressed

button-outline-border.description: 2px outline on dark surfaces (the consent card)
